notes: Strongest route remains a representative or calibrated Hungarian replaced-window Uw distribution. P106 did not identify one publicly.

Questionnaire carries partial/full/no replacement and last-replacement recency. Public questionnaire/guide do not provide realized Uw or frame material; no public response distribution was identified.
National weighted survey provides current replacement-state shares including all 23 calibration types, but replacement label is not U compliance.

EPC-derived Type-5 full-window distribution is filtered 1.10..4.00 W/m2K and fitted Normal mean 2.518 sigma 0.670. The study deliberately models original/uninsulated state and is not a replaced-window subset or national all-archetype surface.

Public EU27 model dataset includes HUN, years 2020..2050, archetype name with renovation generation, areawindows, Htr_w and number_of_buildings. Ueff=Htr_w/areawindows is a model-derived area-weighted effective window coefficient, not observed product Uw.

Independent Invert/FLEX publication explicitly states gen2/gen3/gen4 denote buildings that have undergone renovations, with higher generation numbers representing more recent renovations. This validates generation semantics, not Hungary-specific prevalence.
